usage.purpose: Historical editorial wording, topic selection and cause/consequence patterns only.
usage.safeForPromptMeaning: Agent text-crosschecked stylistic paraphrase, not a current fact or independently verified fact.
usage.preserveConditions: Keep source uncertainty, negation, country, commodity, comparison periods and number units; never borrow historical facts for a new week.

scope.dateBasis: report_date resolved by archive extractor; report heading wins over mismatched filename/board title

limitations: All in-scope extracted records were processed; not every PDF page has been individually visually reviewed.
Unparsed domestic blocks are not silently converted into examples or attributed to invented publishers.
A publisher/title/date citation is not proof that the adjacent table source authored that summary.
Machine-extracted spacing and suspicious quantities are retained with quality flags, never silently corrected.
2025 poultry and egg coverage begins only at the late-December expanded report format; earlier missing sections are not invented.
